note: No .env file is committed. .env.example holds placeholders only. The model is called server-side through LangGraph, and no key reaches the browser. All AI tools are frontend widget actions that change dashboard state only, so no tool writes records. Not reviewed: *.test.tsx files, test.setup.ts, test-utils, eslint and jest configs, DashboardCard.tsx, theme.ts.

labels.what: The /api/copilotkit endpoint has no login or Medplum token check. Anyone who can reach it can run the OpenAI-backed agent. The LangGraph server it forwards to (port 8123) has no auth either
No rate limit, quota or message-size cap on the paid OpenAI agent endpoint

Context sent by the browser (medications, care plans, FHIR search results, widget state) is pasted as JSON into the system prompt with no guard. Record text or a forged request can inject instructions with system-prompt authority
Up to 1000 medications and care plans, plus any FHIR search results, are sent to OpenAI as model context. Patient health data leaves the system with no minimization
Prompt tells the model to give patients health interpretations of their data. There is no output check or clinical review on these answers
Chat history, including patient data, is kept in an in-process MemorySaver with no expiry. It grows without bound and is lost on restart
Fallback thread id uses Date.now and Math.random. Since the agent endpoint has no auth, a guessed thread id could expose another chat's state
Page login check is a client-side redirect only. Medplum still checks the token on data reads, so the main exposure is the unauthenticated agent endpoint

Patient access policy gives write access (create, update, delete) to the patient's Observation, Condition, MedicationRequest, DiagnosticReport, CarePlan, Immunization, AllergyIntolerance, Coverage and PaymentNotice. Clinical and billing records should be read-only for patients
Binary has no compartment criteria and no readonly flag, so every patient can read, change and delete every Binary in the project
Organization, Practitioner, Schedule, Slot, Bot and OperationDefinition are readable project-wide by any patient. Bot includes bot source and config

Drop All Patient Data deletes every Observation, Condition, MedicationRequest, CarePlan and DiagnosticReport for the patient from the browser. Real records are deleted along with sample data because nothing tags sample data
Browser code writes clinical records (observations, medications, conditions, care plans, reports) straight into the patient chart, which the access policy allows

Load Sample Data puts made-up medications, conditions, care plans, lab reports and about a year of generated observations into the signed-in patient's real chart, with no tag marking them as sample. The AI then interprets them as the patient's own health
Scripted weight-loss journey (130 kg to 95 kg) plus fixed curves for blood pressure, heart rate, glucose, HbA1c, cholesterol, eGFR and insulin, and random temperature at line 405
Hardcoded care plans with a made-up care team (Dr. Sarah Chen) and progress notes written as if real
Hardcoded conditions (obesity, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia) with narrative progress notes
Hardcoded prescriptions (lisinopril, metformin, atorvastatin, amoxicillin) with Patient/PLACEHOLDER references
Hardcoded lab reports with placeholder observation references
Observation shells (LOINC code and unit, no values) that the data generator fills with made-up values
Sample weight journey disagrees with itself. The generator uses 130 kg to 95 kg (target 85), while the condition note says 120 kg to 85 kg
Agent URL falls back to http://localhost:8123 when LANGGRAPH_DEPLOYMENT_URL is unset. It only logs a warning. .env.example line 7 uses the same localhost value
Model defaults to gpt-5-mini in code when OPENAI_MODEL is unset
Lab normal ranges are hardcoded in UI code and shown to patients as Normal, High or Low. Open-ended ranges use 999 as a fake maximum
Metformin Safe, Caution or Contraindicated badge from fixed eGFR cutoffs (45 and 30). It is shown to every patient, whether or not they take metformin

Care plan fetch limit is 10 here and 1000 on CarePlansPage, MedicationsPage, the vitals and lab widgets and the delete button. Anything past 1000 is silently dropped, including from Drop All Patient Data
Tool description says count max 100. update_fhir_search clamps it (line 495) but render_fhir_data_table passes the model's count through unchecked
